incidents.title: Mirae Asset Securities hack exposes 39,000 customers and staff
incidents.summary: Mirae Asset Securities said unauthorized external access on 4 and 5 November targeted its mobile-web phone-authentication login service and internal system, leaking about 3,800 customer account numbers and data on 35,255 current, former and contract staff. The company blocked the access routes and reported the incident to the FSC, FSS and PIPC.

incidents.title: Smartbox confirms cyberattack exposing customer personal data
incidents.summary: Smartbox confirmed it was the victim of a cyberattack detected on 3 November, in which unauthorized access to one of its platforms may have exposed customer personal data such as names and email addresses. The disclosure came on 7 November.

incidents.title: Burda Style says customer data exposed after cyberattack
incidents.summary: Burda Style confirmed it was the victim of a cyberattack that exposed the personal data of its customers. The disclosure was reported on 7 November.

incidents.title: Club Tourism partially reopens website after October 30 breach affecting 4.3 million members
incidents.summary: Club Tourism issued a second report stating its website was partially reopened after a breach on October 30. Approximately 4.32 million internet members were affected.

incidents.title: Hacker claims sale of 21,732 Aréas Assurance policyholder records
incidents.summary: A hacker claims to be selling personal information of 21,732 Aréas Assurance policyholders, including first names, surnames, dates of birth and insurance contract numbers. The claim is dated 7 November and has not been confirmed by the insurer.

incidents.title: Hacker claims 969,400 Caverne des Jouets customer records
incidents.summary: A hacker claims to be selling personal information of customers of the French online toy retailer, including names, first names, purchase histories and hashed passwords, affecting 969,400 people. The claim is dated 7 November.

incidents.title: Qilin claims AXE-EXPERTS as ransomware victim
incidents.summary: The Qilin ransomware group lists the French professional services firm AXE-EXPERTS as a victim. The claim is dated 7 November and has not been confirmed by the company.

incidents.title: JNSA security check service hit by unauthorized access
incidents.summary: JNSA announced that its Information Security Comprehension Check Service suffered unauthorized access, with up to 15,128 user records potentially leaked including administrator names, company names, email addresses, user IDs and hashed passwords. The association confirmed the access on 4 November and suspended the service.

incidents.title: Mindfactory discloses cyber incident affecting customer data
incidents.summary: The online PC-hardware retailer made a cyber incident public on 6 November, saying third parties accessed IT systems, likely the shop system. Customer addresses, contact details and encrypted passwords may have been affected, while payment data was not.

incidents.title: Ransomware attack on Swiss healthcare provider Medi Porta
incidents.summary: A ransomware attack exposed sensitive data through local storage systems at the Chur healthcare facility. Medical care continued without interruption.

incidents.title: Ransomware steals patient data from Medizinisches Zentrum Gleis D
incidents.summary: A ransomware attack stole names, addresses, prescriptions and X-ray images, while electronic patient records remained unaffected. The incident at the Chur medical center was reported on 6 November.

incidents.title: Secours Islamique France says donor data exposed in cyberattack
incidents.summary: SIF confirmed it was the victim of a cyberattack that exposed donors' personal data including names, postal addresses, email addresses, phone numbers and donation information. The incident was disclosed on 6–7 November.

incidents.title: Delcampe confirms security incident exposing collectors' data
incidents.summary: The collectibles marketplace confirmed a security incident that exposed users' names, pseudonyms, postal addresses, credentials and purchase information. The company disclosed the incident on 6 November.

incidents.title: WS Audiology hack deprives Widex and Signia users of settings
incidents.summary: The hearing-aid manufacturer, owner of the Widex and Signia brands, confirmed a cyberattack that deprived users of certain device settings. The incident was reported on 6 November.

incidents.title: Transcontinents confirms theft of traveler booking data
incidents.summary: The travel agency based in La Réunion confirmed unauthorized access that stole booking data including traveler names, email addresses, phone numbers and reserved hotel names. Clients subsequently received fake WhatsApp messages.

incidents.title: Rohto Pharmaceutical mail-order breach affects 2.79 million people
incidents.summary: Pharmaceutical company Rohto reported a data breach affecting 2.79 million people through its mail-order phone system. The incident included the exposure of 9,715 credit card numbers.

incidents.title: Nissan Financial Services confirms up to 236 thousand customer records leaked via subcontractor
incidents.summary: Nissan Financial Services confirmed a breach at a subcontractor's system. Up to 236,000 customer records were potentially leaked.

incidents.title: TeamSpirit confirms 28 thousand personal records leaked from development server breach
incidents.summary: TeamSpirit confirmed that a software development server was breached by a third party. 28,824 personal records were leaked.

incidents.title: Mizkan confirms 29 member records leaked and 487 altered in Mizkan 365 community site breach
incidents.summary: Mizkan confirmed unauthorized access to its 'Mizkan 365' community site. Data for 487 members was altered, and 29 records were leaked.

incidents.title: Mitsui Direct General Insurance leak affects 230,000 policyholders
incidents.summary: Mitsui Direct General Insurance disclosed that unauthorized access led to the leak of more than 230,000 items of policyholder personal information. The leaked data includes names, addresses, and phone numbers.

incidents.title: Bookoff Group HD confirms 6.4 million records leaked due to access-control flaw
incidents.summary: Bookoff Group HD identified an access-control flaw as the cause of a breach. The scope remains at 6,427,735 records affecting 6,383,279 people.

incidents.title: Air Creebec regional airline suffers cyberattack compromising information
incidents.summary: Air Creebec suffered a cyberattack and stated that information was compromised. Specific record counts were not stated.

incidents.title: Stockal confirms unauthorized trades in 13 customer accounts
incidents.summary: Stockal confirmed that an unauthorized third party logged into 26 customer accounts using valid credentials, executing unauthorized trades in 13 accounts. No funds were withdrawn.

incidents.title: Gnosis Pay confirms data leak affecting crypto debit card system
incidents.summary: Gnosis Pay confirmed a data breach affecting the system behind its Visa debit cards on November 6, 2026. Customer data was viewed, user balances were unaffected, and additional security requirements for online payments were introduced.

incidents.title: Doctor Anywhere hit by data breach due to malicious cyber incident
incidents.summary: Doctor Anywhere said personal data of users was leaked in a malicious cyber incident involving unauthorized access by an unknown third party. The firm has not disclosed how many customers were affected or what specific data types were compromised.

incidents.title: Court upholds record fine on Coupang over massive personal data breach
incidents.summary: A Seoul court upheld a record 423.6 billion won fine on e-commerce giant Coupang over a personal data breach affecting approximately 37.5 million people. The court rejected Coupang's request to suspend the penalty.

incidents.title: Pharmagest security flaw may expose pharmacy patient data
incidents.summary: A possible security flaw in Pharmagest software used by thousands of French pharmacies raised concerns that patient data could be exposed. The issue was reported on 6 November.

incidents.title: Brazil Mato Grosso Health Department hit by cyberattack
incidents.summary: The Brazilian health department was hit by a cyberattack in 2026, reported on November 6, 2026. Specific details regarding the nature of the attack or data exposure were not provided in the source.

incidents.title: Azion reported down following cyber incident
incidents.summary: Azion was reported down following a cyber incident. No specific data leak count was stated.

incidents.title: Polymarket prediction market hack steals 2.7 million dollars
incidents.summary: Prediction market platform Polymarket suffered a hack resulting in the theft of 2.7 million dollars from 700 users. The incident has raised concerns about security vulnerabilities in decentralized finance platforms.

incidents.title: Akira claims 150 GB of Ligne Roset confidential documents
incidents.summary: The Akira ransomware group claims to hold 150 GB of confidential documents from the French furniture maker, including identity documents. The claim was reported on 6 November and has not been confirmed by the company.

incidents.title: N0n claims ransomware attack on Dompé Farmaceutici
incidents.summary: N0n claimed responsibility for a ransomware attack on Dompé Farmaceutici S.p.A., an Italian pharmaceutical company. The group posted claims data warehouse information on its leak site.

incidents.title: Calvary Christian College data breach linked to Qilin ransomware
incidents.summary: Calvary Christian College reported a data breach, with threat actor Qilin named as the responsible party. The discovery date was November 6, 2026.

incidents.title: Outfront Media Inc. (OUT) discloses a cybersecurity incident in an 8-K
incidents.summary: Outfront Media Inc. filed a Form 8-K with the SEC on 2026-11-05 that discusses a cybersecurity incident. Read the filing for scope and impact.

incidents.title: Iberostar hotel chain breach exposes guest personal data and bookings
incidents.summary: Hotel chain Iberostar warned customers of a summer cyberattack that may have exposed guest personal data, including names, emails, stay dates, and hotel booking information. Fraudulent emails are targeting guests.

incidents.title: SMBC Consumer Finance breach exposes data of 320,118 people
incidents.summary: Security engineers noticed unusual traffic on third-party credit-guarantee systems on 2 November and cut the environment off from external networks. Forensic review found an unauthorized party had queried and sent out personal and financial records of up to 320,118 people, with dozens of partner banks affected through the shared platform.

incidents.title: Brazil's FGC discloses unauthorized access to guarantee payment flow
incidents.summary: The deposit-insurance fund reported unauthorized access detected on 26 October to its guarantee-payment flow, exposing names, CPF numbers, email addresses and dates of birth. Around R$51.8bn in payments to creditors of Banco Master, Will Bank and Banco Pleno were unaffected.

incidents.title: Swiss butcher shop refrigeration manipulated in cross-border campaign
incidents.summary: Lüthi’s Fleischwaren branch in Köniz closed temporarily after attackers manipulated refrigeration controls and raised temperatures sharply. This is part of a broader campaign across Europe.

incidents.title: Ransomware paralyses ISAE-Supméca engineering school
incidents.summary: Ransomware on 31 October paralysed the engineering school's entire IT infrastructure and ANSSI was mobilised. The establishment published a statement on 5 November.

incidents.title: Bureau Vallée confirms two cyber incidents as hackers claim 4.8 million
incidents.summary: Bureau Vallée confirmed two separate security incidents that resulted in the theft of customer data, while hackers claimed 4.8 million customers were affected. The disclosure was reported on 5 November.

incidents.title: Grand Paris Grand Est reports resident data exposed via contractor flaw
incidents.summary: The territorial public authority informed residents that a security incident exposed personal data of users of its bulky-waste collection service, following a flaw detected on 28 September on the Wastreet platform used by contractor SEPUR. The notification was reported on 5 November.

incidents.title: Illicado says attacker recovered corporate digital gift cards
incidents.summary: Illicado confirmed it was the victim of a cyberattack in which an individual bypassed protections and fraudulently recovered copies of corporate digital gift cards. The incident occurred on 1 November and was reported on 5 November.

incidents.title: Inovie confirms patient data leak at several labs following Maileva cyberattack
incidents.summary: French medical biology group Inovie confirmed a leak of patient data at several of its laboratories following the cyberattack on Maileva, a service provider. Inovie recognized it could not establish the list of potentially affected patients.

incidents.title: Flandre Opale Habitat tenant data exposed via Maileva breach
incidents.summary: The social housing provider confirmed that personal, administrative and financial data of some tenants may have been compromised through a security incident at Maileva, its mail-sending provider. The disclosure was reported on 5 November.

incidents.victim: Secretaría Distrital de Movilidad de Bogotá
incidents.title: Bogotá municipal transport platform hit by cyberattack
incidents.summary: The Secretaría Distrital de Movilidad de Bogotá reported containing an attack on a digital platform for road access permits. Authorities initiated containment measures to restore services.

incidents.victim: Câmara Municipal de Santa Maria da Feira
incidents.title: Portuguese municipality IT services disrupted after cyberattack
incidents.summary: Câmara Municipal de Santa Maria da Feira reported disruptions to municipal IT services along with email and landline communications following a cyberattack. Services are being restored.

incidents.title: DigiCert confirms data breach exposes customer PII and IDs
incidents.summary: DigiCert confirmed a data breach after a server migration mistakenly exposed an internal business system to the internet. Unauthorized access occurred between June 27 and July 2, 2026, affecting archived customer information and identity documents.

incidents.title: Lisa Jo Adornetto DDS reports data breach affecting 2000 patients
incidents.summary: A North Carolina dental practice reported a data security incident to the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services affecting approximately 2,000 people. An investigation was opened by legal counsel on November 5, 2026.

incidents.title: Shinhan Bank among 37 Korean firms with leaked financial data
incidents.summary: The Financial Services Commission confirmed that 25,000 customer records had been leaked from Shinhan Bank. This was one of 40 reported breaches across 37 financial firms in South Korea.

incidents.title: ARTPASS ticketing platform data breach impacts 1 million users
incidents.summary: Museum and art ticketing platform ARTPASS reported a data breach affecting up to 1 million email addresses. The leak stemmed from the compromise of its email marketing vendor Arara.

incidents.title: Japan Subway confirms 1.1 million records including club card data leaked via AraRa
incidents.summary: Japan Subway confirmed that customer information, including legacy Subway Club Card data, was leaked via the compromised AraRa email distribution service. The total affected records are up to 1,107,494.

incidents.title: Kakaku.com and Tabelog suffer data breach affecting 5.7 million users
incidents.summary: Price comparison site Kakaku.com and restaurant guide Tabelog confirmed a data breach affecting approximately 5.7 million combined user records. The leak stemmed from the Arara email service compromise.

incidents.title: GMO MakeShop data breach impacts 12.6 million e-commerce customers
incidents.summary: E-commerce platform GMO MakeShop reported a data breach affecting 12.6 million accounts. The incident resulted from unauthorized access to its email distribution service provided by Arara.

incidents.title: GMO Payment Service data breach impacts 106 thousand customers
incidents.summary: Payment processing subsidiary GMO Payment Service reported a data breach affecting up to 106,997 customer records. The leak originated from the compromise of its email marketing vendor Arara.

incidents.title: Sumitomo Mitsui Banking confirms 227 thousand email addresses leaked via AraRa
incidents.summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Banking confirmed that email recipients for its distributed messages were leaked via the AraRa vendor. 227,216 email addresses were affected.

incidents.title: Sakai City e-application system breach affects 290 thousand emails
incidents.summary: Sakai City government announced that up to 290,000 email addresses were at risk due to unauthorized access to its e-application system. The city is notifying affected residents.

incidents.title: Edogawa Ward My Number card appointment emails potentially leaked via AraRa
incidents.summary: Edogawa Ward announced that appointment emails for My Number cards were potentially leaked via the AraRa email distribution service. Specific record counts were not stated.

incidents.title: Matsui Securities confirms up to 830 thousand email addresses leaked via AraRa
incidents.summary: Matsui Securities confirmed that customer email addresses were leaked via the AraRa email distribution service. Up to 830,000 records were potentially exposed.

incidents.title: Konaka Group confirms 434 thousand email addresses leaked via AraRa supply chain
incidents.summary: Konaka and its subsidiaries Samantha Thavasa Japan and Barnet Store Japan confirmed that email addresses were leaked via the AraRa vendor. 434,414 records were affected.

incidents.title: Japan Lottery Association suspends official site after passwords unintentionally changed
incidents.summary: The Japan Lottery Association suspended its official lottery website after users reported that passwords were unintentionally changed. No specific data leak count was stated.

incidents.title: Chikugo City website defaced and temporarily closed after hack
incidents.summary: Chikugo City government website was temporarily closed following unauthorized access. Authorities are investigating the incident and assessing whether any data was exfiltrated.

incidents.title: Sompo Japan Insurance confirms up to 65 thousand customer records leaked via PCS subcontractor
incidents.summary: Sompo Japan Insurance confirmed a breach at subcontractor PCS. Approximately 65,000 customer records were potentially leaked.

incidents.title: Iris Ohyama discloses up to 7.7 million customer records may have leaked
incidents.summary: Iris Ohyama disclosed that unauthorized access to its online store 'Iris Plaza' potentially exposed the personal data of up to 7.7 million customers. The company confirmed names, addresses, and emails were at risk, but credit card data was not included.

incidents.title: Euglena confirms 490 thousand login accounts and 900 thousand registration records leaked
incidents.summary: Euglena confirmed a breach of its 'akyrise' cosmetics EC site. Up to 490,000 login accounts and 900,000 registration/purchase records were affected.

incidents.title: Shift Up Nikke PC launcher CDN files altered distributing malware since September
incidents.summary: Shift Up and Level Infinite confirmed that PC launcher CDN files for 'Goddess of Victory: Nikke' were altered on September 27, distributing malware.

incidents.title: Royal Cornwall Hospitals Trust admits failings over staff data breach affecting 8 thousand
incidents.summary: Royal Cornwall Hospitals Trust admitted a data breach exposed sensitive personal health information relating to almost 8,000 current and former staff.

incidents.title: Prairie Ridge Integrated Behavioral Healthcare confirms data breach
incidents.summary: Prairie Ridge Integrated Behavioral Healthcare confirmed a data breach. Specific record counts were not stated in the initial disclosure.

incidents.title: Hackers poison cPGuard updates compromising nearly 3,000 servers
incidents.summary: Attackers poisoned cPGuard security updates after breaching developer OPSSHIELD's update infrastructure, compromising nearly 3,000 Linux servers. The malicious code executed with root privileges, exposing sensitive credentials.

incidents.title: India flags Chinese-linked AI tools in hacking campaign against banks
incidents.summary: India's CERT-In named the hacking group 'Crafty Falcon' behind a wave of AI-driven attacks on financial firms. The campaign affected non-bank lenders, fintech firms, and cryptocurrency exchanges using tools linked to China.

incidents.title: German bakery refrigeration reaches 150°C in cross-border attack
incidents.summary: Pflugsmühle in Abenberg, Bavaria, experienced refrigeration temperatures reaching up to 150°C due to unauthorized manipulation. The incident caused around €5,000 in losses and is part of a wider campaign.

incidents.title: Fire and Disaster Management Agency safety system breached
incidents.summary: Japan's Fire and Disaster Management Agency confirmed unauthorized access to its 'Safety Confirmation System'. The agency is investigating the extent of the breach and potential data exposure.

incidents.title: Yokohama City e-application service breach affects 820 thousand
incidents.summary: Yokohama City government reported that approximately 820,000 records may have been compromised via its e-application email service. An investigation is underway to determine the full impact.

incidents.title: Marathon Health data breach alert issued for patient SSNs and addresses
incidents.summary: Healthcare provider Marathon Health notified individuals that their personal information, including Social Security numbers and addresses, may have been stolen in a data breach occurring in August 2026.

incidents.title: Mato Grosso health department hit by second cyber incident in 2026
incidents.summary: The Mato Grosso state health department suffered a cyberattack on November 1, 2026, temporarily suspending systems at linked units. Urgent care and hospital services continued operating with restricted network access.

incidents.title: Danfoss confirms refrigeration controllers involved in European supermarket hacks
incidents.summary: Danfoss confirmed that its refrigeration controllers were involved in the wave of cyberattacks affecting supermarkets across Europe. The company noted that over 1,000 of its StoreView interfaces remain reachable from the internet.

incidents.title: South Korea FSC investigates 37 finance firms over data leaks affecting 473,000 records
incidents.summary: The Financial Services Commission of South Korea disclosed that cyberattacks on 37 financial companies exposed approximately 473,000 records and resulted in the theft of roughly 1 billion won. The regulator is investigating 580 firms.

incidents.title: Le Code by DEKRA driving-test candidate data exposed
incidents.summary: Personal data of driving-test candidates from several driving schools was exposed in a cybersecurity incident affecting Le Code by DEKRA. The incident was reported on 5 November.

incidents.title: UK food supplier Langridge Organic hit by refrigeration cyber attack
incidents.summary: Attackers remotely manipulated refrigeration systems at the UK food supplier, altering temperature settings and triggering defrost cycles. The incident was reported on November 5, 2026, as part of a wider European campaign.

incidents.title: Cryptocurrency exchange Bithumb reports employee system breach
incidents.summary: An employee support system at the cryptocurrency exchange was breached, reported on November 5, 2026, amidst a wider wave of financial sector leaks in South Korea. Details on the scope of the breach were limited.

incidents.title: cPGuard update channel compromised affecting thousands of servers
incidents.summary: Attackers turned the trusted security update channel into a supply-chain attack, executing malicious code with root privileges on nearly 3,000 Linux servers. The compromise was reported between November 4 and 5, 2026.

incidents.title: LighterPack website down following cyber incident
incidents.summary: LighterPack's website went down following a cyber incident. No specific data leak count was stated.

incidents.title: Attacker arah claims Forum-Pompier data compromise
incidents.summary: An attacker using the pseudonym arah claims to have compromised 65,694 accounts and around 133,000 private messages from the French firefighter forum. The claim was reported on 5 November.

incidents.title: Attacker republishes data of 66,659 CCAS Dunkerque users
incidents.summary: Data attributed to the Dunkirk municipal social action centre reappeared on a cybercriminal forum, involving 66,659 user records. The reposted claim was reported on 5 November.

incidents.victim: Fédération Française de Tennis de Table (FFTT)
incidents.title: Attacker ChimeraZ claims 1.6 million FFTT records for sale
incidents.summary: A user using the pseudonym ChimeraZ offered for sale a database attributed to the French table tennis federation, allegedly affecting 1.6 million people. The claim is dated 5 November.

incidents.title: Whitearmor claims ransomware attack on Unilever
incidents.summary: Whitearmor claimed a ransomware attack on Unilever, the British multinational consumer goods company headquartered in London. The group threatened to leak sensitive data unless negotiations are initiated.

incidents.title: Akira claims ransomware attack on System Plus IT infrastructure firm
incidents.summary: The Akira ransomware group claimed responsibility for an attack on System Plus, a US-based IT infrastructure supplier. The group threatened to upload 30GB of corporate data including employee information and contracts.

incidents.title: N0n claims ransomware attack on Delta Dental of Missouri
incidents.summary: The N0n ransomware group claimed responsibility for an attack on Delta Dental of Missouri, exposing member records including names, Social Security numbers, and treatment details. The group marked the case as exposed.

incidents.title: Redact ransomware group claims attack on Omni Hotels and Resorts
incidents.summary: The Redact ransomware group claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Omni Hotels and Resorts. The claim was reported on November 5, 2026, with no further details on the incident.

incidents.title: N0n claims ransomware attack on Saudi Arabian retail giant
incidents.summary: N0n claimed responsibility for a cyberattack on Company #127, a leading fashion and lifestyle retailer based in Saudi Arabia. The group has indicated a potential data exposure if their demands are not met.

incidents.title: DreamHost web hosting provider breach exposes customer emails
incidents.summary: Web hosting provider DreamHost confirmed that hackers stole customer emails and credentials. The company is investigating the extent of the breach and advising customers to change their passwords.

incidents.title: NTT Docomo says up to 300,000 records breached
incidents.summary: President Yoshiaki Maeda said unauthorized access exposed up to around 300,000 sets of personal data including names, addresses, identity-document numbers and bank account numbers. Online services including My docomo were suspended and no credit card data was compromised.

incidents.title: Muji says 1.09 million customer records may have leaked
incidents.summary: The Muji operator said unauthorized system access may have exposed about 1.09 million customer records, including full credit card numbers and dates of birth for some 345,000 valid Muji Card holders. Cardholder names and CVV codes were not included; a further 120 records with partial card numbers were exposed via the app or online store.

incidents.title: Securitize Japan breach exposes Sony Bank and NTT Data data
incidents.summary: A cyberattack on Securitize Japan exposed customer data held by Sony Bank, NTT Data and Marui Group, which all acknowledged the breach. Attackers exploited a platform authentication flaw to gain administrator rights and steal data.

incidents.title: Sony Bank says 617 names leaked in Securitize Japan breach
incidents.summary: Sony Bank identified the incident on 30 October after noticing a hack at an outside contractor handling its digital securities, and on 4 November named Securitize Japan as that contractor. The leak exposed 617 names and four full customer profiles.

incidents.title: Serpro reports unprecedented cyberattack on Gov.br platform
incidents.summary: Serpro's new-business director André Picoli Agatte disclosed an unprecedented cyberattack against Gov.br and its technology structures during the company's AI Week. The platform has 179.5 million active accounts and no details on affected systems or impact were given.

incidents.title: Cyberattack forces AWO Ruhr-Lippe-Ems to shut down IT
incidents.summary: A cyberattack on the social welfare organization led to a precautionary shutdown of IT systems affecting around 170 facilities. The incident was reported on 4 November.

incidents.title: Rassemblement National confirms member data leak after cyberattack
incidents.summary: The RN confirmed on 4 November that it had suffered a cyberattack resulting in the disclosure of personal data of some members. A hacker claimed 121,600 people were affected, with names, email addresses and phone numbers exposed.

incidents.title: Ecuador parliament website attacked, IT staff launch investigation
incidents.summary: IT staff stopped an attack on the Asamblea Nacional del Ecuador website and launched an investigation. The attack targeted the parliamentary digital platform.

incidents.title: Kernel publishes notice of security incident after API key abuse
incidents.summary: An unauthorized party used a compromised API key from 24 October, accessed a staff login at Kernel's logging provider and on 3 November used a hosting credential to access four GPU-enabled servers. Kernel said the breach impacted 0.28% of its customers.

incidents.title: Ahold Delhaize discloses October cyber incident impacting Q4 sales
incidents.summary: A cybersecurity incident in October forced systems offline, affecting online capabilities in the Benelux and US and disrupting Benelux supply-chain operations. The company disclosed the disruption with Q3 results on November 4, 2026.

incidents.title: Hoag Memorial Hospital Presbyterian confirms data breach filing
incidents.summary: The hospital disclosed a cybersecurity incident confirmed as a data breach via an attorney-general filing on November 4, 2026. The number of records affected was not disclosed in public filings.

incidents.title: Plenus member data leak reaches 7 million users from Arara attack
incidents.summary: Retailer Plenus, operator of the Hottomotto fashion brand, disclosed that up to 7 million member records were leaked due to the Arara supply-chain compromise. The incident occurred between October 28 and 31.

incidents.title: Chobirich beauty platform data breach affects 1.3 million users
incidents.summary: Beauty product review platform Chobirich confirmed a data breach affecting 1.3 million email addresses. The incident resulted from unauthorized access to its email marketing provider Arara.

incidents.title: Mos Food Services breach affects 7.5 million customers via supplier
incidents.summary: Fast-food chain Mos Burger reported a data breach impacting 7.5 million customer records following the compromise of its email marketing provider Arara. Personal information was potentially accessed.

incidents.title: Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance and Aioi Nissay Dowa Insurance confirm unauthorized access to own systems
incidents.summary: Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance and Aioi Nissay Dowa Insurance confirmed unauthorized access to their own systems on November 2. Customer-facing services were suspended.

incidents.title: Uchikomi discloses July server failure was actually a ransomware attack
incidents.summary: Uchikomi disclosed that a server failure occurring on July 6 was caused by a ransomware attack. No specific record count was stated.

incidents.title: HCA Healthcare discloses August cyberattack compromising patient and employee data
incidents.summary: HCA Healthcare disclosed a cybersecurity incident first identified on August 12, 2026. The threat actor obtained copies of HR files containing medical resident personal information including SSNs and immigration details.

incidents.title: Blossom Health announces data breach impacting user data
incidents.summary: Blossom Health announced a data breach. Specific record counts were not stated in the initial disclosure.

incidents.title: Iperius cyberattack affects backup and remote software services
incidents.summary: Iperius suffered a cyberattack affecting its backup and remote software. Services were offline.

incidents.title: PŸUR reports data leak of bank details and mandates
incidents.summary: PŸUR (Tele Columbus) reported a cyberattack spanning mid-September to early October 2026, with contract numbers, names, and bank details among the leaked data according to customer letters. The incident affects former and current customers.

incidents.title: Kyiv Independent website compromised in suspected Russian cyberattack
incidents.summary: Attackers compromised the Kyiv Independent website and newsletter service to distribute false messages. The news outlet reported the incident as a suspected Russian cyberattack.

incidents.title: Workman apparel retailer data breach impacts 1.45 million customers
incidents.summary: Apparel retailer Workman confirmed a data breach affecting up to 1.45 million customer email addresses. The leak resulted from unauthorized access to its email marketing provider Arara.

incidents.title: Seven-Eleven Japan delivery contractor breach affects 160 thousand
incidents.summary: Convenience store operator Seven-Eleven Japan confirmed a data breach affecting over 160,000 records. The leak originated from a delivery service contractor's system compromise.

incidents.title: Cognitive Health Technologies breach exposes medical data of 49,467 people
incidents.summary: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services Office for Civil Rights confirmed that Cognitive Health Technologies suffered a hacking incident impacting 49,467 individuals. The files taken included names, dates of birth, health insurance information, and medical histories.

incidents.title: Email vendor Araara suffers unauthorized access causing client leaks
incidents.summary: The email-distribution vendor Araara suffered unauthorized access to its systems. This supply-chain compromise led to successive data leaks at multiple client organizations using its services.

incidents.title: Police investigate major cybersecurity breach at NSW Health Oral Health Scheme
incidents.summary: NSW Health reported a cybersecurity breach at its Oral Health Fee For Service Scheme website, declared a major incident. Cyber Security NSW stated no patient data was compromised, but a hacker claimed to have accessed about 100,000 sensitive documents from an isolated server.

incidents.title: NIKKE PC game launcher supply-chain malware attack targeting crypto wallets
incidents.summary: The developers of Goddess of Victory: NIKKE confirmed that hackers tampered with the game's PC launcher scripts in a supply-chain attack, distributing malware capable of stealing credentials and cryptocurrency.

incidents.title: Airdo reports leak linked to Arara email system
incidents.summary: Airdo was among Japanese organizations reporting data leaks linked to the email system operated by Arara, alongside Bic Camera. No credit card details were confirmed in the incident.

incidents.title: Solaseed Air reports leak linked to Arara email system
incidents.summary: Solaseed Air was among Japanese organizations reporting data leaks linked to the email system operated by Arara, alongside Bic Camera. No credit card details were confirmed.

incidents.title: Sutherland Healthcare Solutions breach exposes SSNs and claims data
incidents.summary: Healthcare technology provider Sutherland reported a data breach exposing Social Security numbers and claims data. Attorneys are investigating potential class action claims on behalf of affected individuals.

incidents.title: Partnered Health cyberattack puts GP patient data at risk across Australia
incidents.summary: Australian news reports indicate that Partnered Health, a GP group, suffered a cyberattack that put patient data at risk across Australia. The incident highlights vulnerabilities in healthcare IT systems serving general practitioners.

incidents.title: Akira claims 538 GB of data from Erowa
incidents.summary: The Akira ransomware group claims to hold 538 GB of corporate data from the Swiss manufacturing automation firm, including employee and personal information, contracts, client information and NDAs. The discovery date is 4 November; the claim has not been confirmed by the company.

incidents.title: Global Secret Group claims ransomware attack on Kontron North America
incidents.summary: The Global Secret Group claimed responsibility for a ransomware attack on Kontron North America, a US manufacturer of embedded computing. The group listed properties totaling 2.37 TB of data as stolen.

incidents.title: Pear ransomware group claims attack on gWorks
incidents.summary: The Pear ransomware group claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against gWorks. The claim was reported on November 4, 2026, without victim confirmation.

incidents.title: PayoutsKING claims ransomware attack on US fintech Autoscribe
incidents.summary: The ransomware group PayoutsKING claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Autoscribe Corporation, a US financial technology company providing payment processing solutions. The group threatened to expose sensitive data unless negotiations were initiated.

incidents.title: MortemTeam claims to have leaked 2 TB of Spanish government data
incidents.summary: MortemTeam claimed to have published a report with records attributed to the Government of Spain, covering 2 TB of data. The volume figure is the group's own claim and has not been independently verified.

incidents.title: Rhysida claims ransomware attack on El Cajon California city services
incidents.summary: The Rhysida ransomware group claimed responsibility for an attack on the municipal government of El Cajon, California, including police, 911 dispatch, and production SQL databases. The group threatened to leak live dump data.

incidents.title: Chainstack discloses breach exposing customer data and password hashes
incidents.summary: Blockchain infrastructure provider Chainstack disclosed a cyberattack where an attacker accessed production systems and a database containing customer information and password hashes. The company stated initial access was gained through a third-party component.

incidents.title: SBI confirms 3,897 customer records found on dark web
incidents.summary: SBI said it is investigating a cyberattack that exposed 3,897 customer records containing personally identifiable information on the dark web, after alerts from its threat-intelligence provider, the Defence Cyber Agency and CERT-In. The company said there was no business disruption.

incidents.title: Pluxee Detects Malicious Server Activity Potentially Compromising Data
incidents.summary: Pluxee detected malicious activity on one of its servers, allowing it to quickly secure affected systems and prevent further damage. Names, emails, and telephone numbers were potentially compromised in the incident.

incidents.title: Bank SinoPac reports unauthorized transfers enabled by vendor flaw
incidents.summary: Bank SinoPac reported 427 unauthorized transfers caused by compromised security settings at a technology vendor. The bank stated there was no evidence of customer data leakage.

incidents.title: TUM takes campus management system offline after credential theft
incidents.summary: Compromised credentials were used to access the university's campus management system, which was subsequently taken offline. The IT security incident was reported on 3 November.

incidents.title: Yokohama Rubber contractor breach exposes email addresses
incidents.summary: Tire manufacturer Yokohama Rubber reported unauthorized access to a contractor's system, leading to the exposure of email addresses and other customer data. The full scope of affected records is being assessed.

incidents.title: MoneySmart confirms data breach affecting customers in Singapore and Hong Kong
incidents.summary: Financial comparison platform MoneySmart disclosed that an unauthorized party copied personal data of customers in Singapore and Hong Kong after gaining access to its systems on October 29. The compromised data included recipients' names and email addresses.

incidents.title: ISCO International telecom tech company breach affects wireless networks
incidents.summary: Telecommunications technology company ISCO International experienced a data breach compromising personal information associated with the company. The Massachusetts and Vermont Attorneys General were notified.

incidents.title: 3AM ransomware affiliate targets UK school estate in suspected AI-assisted attack
incidents.summary: A 3AM ransomware affiliate targeted a school estate in the UK, encrypting around 37 of nearly 50 machines reached from an unmanaged host. Researchers believe the threat actor may have used AI-generated commands.

incidents.title: South Korea investigates leak of presidential delegation passport data
incidents.summary: South Korea's Foreign Ministry is investigating the online leak of passport details for President Lee Jae Myung, first lady Kim Hea Kyung, and 166 presidential jet passengers. The ministry is reissuing passports for everyone affected.

incidents.title: Personal information of President Lee Jae-myung and 167 officials leaked
incidents.summary: South Korean media reported that the personal information of President Lee Jae-myung, his wife, and 167 government officials had been exposed on a paid website for five months. The Foreign Ministry acknowledged the leak of passport numbers and dates of birth from a presidential aircraft manifest.

incidents.title: DOJ warns FBI job portal hack likely extends to Justice Department employees
incidents.summary: The Department of Justice warned that a September hack of the FBI’s job portal likely extended to Justice Department employees and may have affected FBI background-check data. The DOJ letter indicated that the breach compromised sensitive personnel information.

incidents.title: 7-Eleven Japan delivery subcontractor PickGo suffers data breach
incidents.summary: 169,151 records were leaked via CBcloud's 'PickGo' delivery service, exposing order recipient names and some addresses. The incident was reported to the Personal Information Protection Commission.

incidents.title: Singapore Airlines confirms 46,000 booking records exposed in Amadeus breach
incidents.summary: Singapore Airlines confirmed that 46,000 booking records were accessed via the Amadeus platform, with 620 records containing sensitive travel document data. Internal IT systems remained secure.

incidents.title: Hanyang Securities confirms customer and staff data leak via groupware
incidents.summary: Hanyang Securities reported that customer and employee information was exposed through an external groupware solution. The leak included names, resident registration numbers, and account details.

incidents.title: CSX transportation company experiences major data privacy breach
incidents.summary: CSX, one of the country's largest transportation companies, experienced a data privacy breach affecting tens of thousands of people nationwide. Employee information was reportedly exposed.

incidents.title: Harvard University data breach exposed 850,500 unique accounts via phishing
incidents.summary: Harvard confirmed that ShinyHunters accessed Alumni Affairs systems via phone-based phishing, leaking names, emails, and donation details. Have I Been Pwned recorded 850,500 unique accounts in the leak.

incidents.title: WorkOS Developer Platform Breached After AI Framework Attack
incidents.summary: Developer platform WorkOS suffered a data breach after a threat actor accessed business contact records and summaries of customer communications. The attacker reportedly used the ARTEX AI framework to breach the internal sales app.

incidents.title: First State Auctions confirms customer data access by unauthorized external party
incidents.summary: First State Auctions confirmed that an unauthorized external party accessed a system holding customer information. A hacking-forum user had previously claimed over 1 million lines of data.

incidents.title: Spandana Sphoorty Financial reports unauthorized transfers of Rs 7.8 crore
incidents.summary: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited reported unauthorized transfers of approximately Rs 7.8 crore from a bank account on November 1. The company sought freezing of recipient accounts.

incidents.title: Mavis Tire Supply LLC confirms data breach exposing customer information
incidents.summary: Mavis Tire Supply LLC confirmed a data breach exposing customer data. A class action investigation has been launched into the incident.

incidents.title: Holcim AG Switzerland building materials data theft claim by Emperador group
incidents.summary: Holcim AG confirmed a cyberattack and data theft claim by the Emperador group, which alleged stealing over 360 GB of files. Production and logistics continued normally despite the incident.

incidents.title: DeepSeek China AI services service outage affecting web and API
incidents.summary: DeepSeek, a Chinese AI services provider, reported a service outage on November 3 affecting its web and API. This was the 19th major outage of the year for the company.

incidents.title: AFIB France banking insurance data leak affecting 3,848 professionals
incidents.summary: AFIB, the Association Française des Intermédiaires en Bancassurance, reported a data leak affecting 3,848 professionals. The hacker Alduin claimed responsibility, and the data includes identities, addresses, and professional references.

incidents.title: N0n claims ransomware attack on US data analytics firm Company #120
incidents.summary: The ransomware group N0n claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Company #120, a US provider of data analytics and AI services. The group threatened to expose sensitive data unless negotiations were initiated by the company.

incidents.title: N0n claims ransomware attack on US online travel firm Company #122
incidents.summary: The ransomware group N0n claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Company #122, a US-based organization operating in the online travel and consumer loyalty sector. The group has threatened to leak sensitive data unless negotiations are initiated.

incidents.title: N0n claims ransomware attack on US mobile advertising firm
incidents.summary: N0n claimed responsibility for a cyberattack on Company #124, a prominent mobile advertising company in the USA. The threat actors indicated that sensitive data may be exposed unless the company initiates negotiations.

incidents.title: N0n claims ransomware attack on US precious metals dealer
incidents.summary: The N0n ransomware group claimed responsibility for a cyberattack on Company #123, a reputable US precious metals dealer. The group warned of impending data exposure unless their demands were met.

incidents.title: N0n claims ransomware attack on US biopharmaceutical firm
incidents.summary: N0n claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Company #125, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical firm specializing in oncology in the USA. The group has threatened to leak sensitive data unless the organization engages in negotiations.

incidents.title: N0n claims ransomware attack on Italian pharmaceutical firm Company #126
incidents.summary: The ransomware group N0n claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Company #126, a prominent pharmaceutical firm in Italy. The group threatened to leak sensitive data unless the company engages in negotiations.

incidents.title: Aoqin claims ransomware attack on Chinese electronics distributor Nextron
incidents.summary: The ransomware group Aoqin claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Nextron Technology (NX Electronics), a Chinese electronics parts distributor. The group threatened to release confidential client data unless demands were met.

incidents.title: N0n claims ransomware attack on US greeting cards retailer Company #121
incidents.summary: The ransomware group N0n publicly claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Company #121, a US-based greeting cards and gifts retailer. The group posted an extortion notice indicating that sensitive data would be leaked unless negotiations were initiated.

incidents.title: N0n claims ransomware attack on UAE fashion retail firm Company #119
incidents.summary: The ransomware group N0n announced their involvement in a ransomware attack targeting Company #119, a leading entity in the fashion retail sector within the UAE. The group stated that the exposure of sensitive data is pending unless their demands are met.

incidents.title: Booba Project Claims Ransomware Attack on Vetstoria Healthcare Tech
incidents.summary: Healthcare technology company Vetstoria was targeted by the Booba Project ransomware group, which claimed responsibility for the attack. The group alleged that 5 GB of veterinary services data was stolen.

incidents.title: TheGentlemen claims data breach of Swiss pharmaceutical company Labatec
incidents.summary: The hacker group TheGentlemen claimed responsibility for a data breach involving Labatec Pharma SA, a privately owned Swiss pharmaceutical company. The claim was reported on November 3, 2026, though the leak size was unknown.

incidents.title: OBSOFT claims ransomware attack on South Korean firm Guardian
incidents.summary: The ransomware group OBSOFT publicly claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Company #2, identified as guardian.co.kr, a prominent organization based in South Korea. The group announced that data destruction was completed, significantly impacting operations.

incidents.title: Healthstream Inc (HSTM) discloses a cybersecurity incident in an 8-K
incidents.summary: Healthstream Inc filed a Form 8-K with the SEC on 2026-11-02 that discusses a cybersecurity incident. Read the filing for scope and impact.

incidents.title: Chainalysis discloses AI-driven cyberattack exposing non-sensitive customer data
incidents.summary: Blockchain analytics company Chainalysis disclosed a data breach resulting from an AI-driven cyberattack that accessed user IDs, full names, email addresses, and organization role labels. The company took KYT offline after detecting abnormal activity during investigation.

incidents.title: Paycloud Subsidiary Leaks 77 Million Email Addresses in Server Breach
incidents.summary: Paycloud Holdings subsidiary Arara Message leaked about 77 million email addresses after hackers gained unauthorized access to its servers. The breach exposed registered information for up to 380 corporate clients, including names and addresses, but no credit card numbers were compromised.

incidents.title: European supermarkets hit by new fridge cyberattack
incidents.summary: Supermarkets across Sweden, Belgium, Ireland, and Estonia reported overnight cyberattacks that disabled refrigeration systems, forcing retailers to discard spoiled products. Hackers exploited vulnerabilities in Danfoss refrigeration controllers.

incidents.title: European supermarkets hit by new fridge cyberattack
incidents.summary: Supermarkets across Sweden, Belgium, Ireland, and Estonia reported overnight cyberattacks that disabled refrigeration systems, forcing retailers to discard spoiled products. Hackers exploited vulnerabilities in Danfoss refrigeration controllers.

incidents.title: European supermarkets hit by new fridge cyberattack
incidents.summary: Supermarkets across Sweden, Belgium, Ireland, and Estonia reported overnight cyberattacks that disabled refrigeration systems, forcing retailers to discard spoiled products. Hackers exploited vulnerabilities in Danfoss refrigeration controllers.

incidents.title: European supermarkets hit by new fridge cyberattack
incidents.summary: Supermarkets across Sweden, Belgium, Ireland, and Estonia reported overnight cyberattacks that disabled refrigeration systems, forcing retailers to discard spoiled products. Hackers exploited vulnerabilities in Danfoss refrigeration controllers.

incidents.title: HYBE Confirms Cyberattack Exposing Employee IDs and Medical Data
incidents.summary: HYBE confirmed that hackers accessed its internal systems twice, exposing employee ID numbers, passport data, bank accounts, and medical records. The breach affected direct employees and partner company staff, with no suspected misuse reported.

incidents.title: Nomura Investor Relations reports breach of Institutional Navi service
incidents.summary: The Nomura Holdings subsidiary said its Institutional Navi information service was subject to unauthorized access resulting in a data breach, with names and email addresses possibly leaked. The service was suspended while the company investigated.

incidents.title: Bic Camera says 14.9 million records may have leaked
incidents.summary: The electronics retailer said about 14.9 million customer records including email addresses may have leaked through unauthorized access to a contractor's email newsletter distribution system. No credit card details were confirmed as exposed.

incidents.title: Tele Columbus customer letters report leaked bank and contract data
incidents.summary: Customer letters reported that contract numbers, names, bank details, booking data and direct-debit mandates had leaked, including for former customers. The attack occurred between mid-September and early October and was reported on 4 November.

incidents.title: Cyberattack disrupts blood storage refrigeration systems in France
incidents.summary: The French Blood Establishment (EFS) confirmed a cyberattack targeting a refrigeration equipment provider raised temperature settings at three facilities. The incident threatened stored blood products but did not directly compromise EFS systems.

incidents.title: mSecure password manager breach prompts password reset warnings
incidents.summary: The developer of the mSecure password manager disclosed a data breach after detecting suspicious activity involving its application, in which an attacker stole an encrypted database containing mSecure Cloud user information. The company notified customers and advised changing master passwords, resetting 2FA and replacing passkeys.

incidents.title: University Hospitals continues system restoration after October cyberattack
incidents.summary: Cleveland-based University Hospitals activated incident response protocols after identifying a cybersecurity incident on October 22. Digital services, including MyChart, remain offline as systems are restored.

incidents.title: Suntory Holdings Confirms Data Leak Affecting 100,000 People
incidents.summary: Suntory Holdings reported that unauthorized access to an external cloud service leaked personal data of around 100,000 people. The exposed data included employee names and emails, business program registrant emails, and graduate applicant names.

incidents.title: Notebooksbilliger Notifies Customers of Cyberattack Stealing Bank Data
incidents.summary: Online retailer notebooksbilliger.de notified customers about a criminal cyberattack where unauthorized access may have led to the theft of bank account numbers. The company detected the intrusion on October 12 and confirmed passwords were not affected.

incidents.title: Carrefour Belgium confirms impact from pan-European fridge cyberattacks
incidents.summary: Carrefour Belgium confirmed that its stores were among those affected by a suspected cyberattack on supermarket refrigeration systems. The incident forced some outlets to discard spoiled stock.

incidents.title: De Laet & Van Haver supermarket refrigeration systems hit by cyberattack
incidents.summary: De Laet & Van Haver reported that refrigeration temperatures rose following unauthorized access, spoiling meat worth around €15,000. The incident is part of a coordinated campaign across Europe.

incidents.victim: Ministry of Emergency Situations of Russia
incidents.title: Ministry of Emergency Situations Russia government warning app false alerts distributed
incidents.summary: The Ministry of Emergency Situations of Russia reported a cyberattack on November 2 that caused false alerts to be distributed through its government warning app. The incident is under investigation.

incidents.title: Sega confirms unauthorized access to arcade network servers ALL.Net and Aime
incidents.summary: Sega confirmed unauthorized third-party access to servers related to its ALL.Net and Aime arcade network services. Services were suspended from November 1, putting arcade machines into offline mode.

incidents.title: TKC stops email services after Arara breach exposes client addresses
incidents.summary: Up to 2,230,812 client email addresses were found in the scope of the Arara leak, prompting TKC to halt email sending from its accounting and municipal systems. The company is investigating the full impact with Arara.

incidents.title: IKEA Belgium furniture store reports interference with refrigeration equipment
incidents.summary: IKEA Belgium reported interference with its refrigeration equipment on November 2. The incident is linked to a broader campaign targeting supermarket and food-industry refrigeration systems.

incidents.title: Intermarché Belgium refrigeration systems tampered with at around 15 stores
incidents.summary: Intermarché Belgium reported that refrigeration systems were tampered with at around 15 stores. The extent of product losses is unclear, but the incident is linked to a broader campaign.

incidents.title: Spar Colruyt Group refrigeration equipment manipulated at five stores
incidents.summary: Spar / Colruyt Group reported that refrigeration equipment was manipulated at five stores. The incident is part of a coordinated campaign targeting supermarket refrigeration systems across Europe.

incidents.title: CAP-Supermarkt Volmarstein Germany retail food refrigeration temperatures rose
incidents.summary: CAP-Supermarkt Volmarstein reported that refrigeration temperatures rose on November 2, leading to food removal. The incident is part of a coordinated campaign targeting supermarket refrigeration systems across Europe.

incidents.title: Supermarkt Raesfeld Germany retail food refrigeration temperatures rose
incidents.summary: Supermarkt Raesfeld reported that refrigeration temperatures rose on November 2, leading to food removal. The incident is part of a coordinated campaign targeting supermarket refrigeration systems across Europe.

incidents.title: Selver Estonia retail food refrigeration equipment interference reported
incidents.summary: Selver reported interference with refrigeration equipment at one store in Tallinn on November 2. The incident is linked to a broader campaign targeting supermarket refrigeration systems across Europe.

incidents.victim: Ayuntamiento de San Cristóbal de La Laguna
incidents.title: Ayuntamiento de San Cristóbal de La Laguna Spain municipal government cyberattack
incidents.summary: The Ayuntamiento de San Cristóbal de La Laguna reported a cyberattack on November 2 that disrupted online administration, tax, and accounting systems. The incident is under investigation.

incidents.title: K Group Kesko Finland retail food refrigeration systems tampered with
incidents.summary: K Group / Kesko reported that refrigeration systems were tampered with at several stores in Helsinki on November 2. The incident is part of a coordinated campaign targeting supermarket refrigeration systems across Europe.

incidents.title: Cyberattacks on food refrigeration systems affect multiple Coop stores in Italy
incidents.summary: At least three Coop stores in Catania and one in Palermo were reported affected by cyberattacks on food refrigeration systems. Other cases involved catering companies in Tuscany and Emilia-Romagna.

incidents.title: Intermarché Grupo Mosqueteiros Portugal retail food refrigeration incidents
incidents.summary: Intermarché / Grupo Mosqueteiros reported refrigeration incidents at seven Intermarché stores in Portugal on November 2. An external refrigeration management provider was targeted.

incidents.title: Nojima confirms about 7 million customer records leaked from e-commerce site
incidents.summary: Nojima disclosed that unauthorized access to its 'Nojima Online' e-commerce site and used-phone buyback site resulted in the leakage of approximately 7 million member records. The company confirmed external leakage had occurred.

incidents.title: istyle confirms @cosme member data leak via unauthorized access
incidents.summary: Approximately 3 million members were affected by unauthorized access that exposed skin/hair types and contact details but no passwords or card data. The incident was reported to the Personal Information Protection Commission.

incidents.title: Hokuriku Electric Power member emails leaked via contractor service
incidents.summary: Approximately 550,000 'hoku-link' member email addresses were leaked through a contractor's mail service linked to the Arara platform. No other personal data beyond emails was confirmed lost.

incidents.title: Osaka Gas FitDish email addresses leaked via Arara message service
incidents.summary: 34,489 FitDish email addresses were confirmed leaked via the Arara messaging service during October. The incident highlights risks in third-party marketing tools used by major utility companies.

incidents.title: Ryukyu Bank customer emails exposed via repica mailing service
incidents.summary: 96,477 customer email addresses were leaked through the 'repica' mailing service provided by Arara. A follow-up report on November 4 confirmed the extent of the exposure.

incidents.title: NetMile operator warns up to 5.49 million personal records may be leaked
incidents.summary: The operator of the NetMile point-exchange service announced that unauthorized access may have exposed up to 5.49 million people's personal information. Details of the specific data types were pending.

incidents.title: Prestige International roadside assistance system breached affecting 5.5m
incidents.summary: Prestige International confirmed that up to 5.5 million records from a group company's roadside assistance system were taken externally. Data included names, addresses, and vehicle information.

incidents.title: Cathay Pacific joins list of airlines hit by Amadeus reservation breach
incidents.summary: Cathay Pacific stated that around 53,000 bookings were affected by unauthorized access to Amadeus reservation data. Most records contained flight details, though some included contact info.

incidents.title: Japan Airlines reports 92,000 customer records exposed in Amadeus attack
incidents.summary: Japan Airlines confirmed that approximately 92,000 customer records were exposed in the cyberattack on travel provider Amadeus. The airline is assessing the specific data types involved.

incidents.title: ANA Holdings discloses up to 37,800 passenger records leaked via Amadeus
incidents.summary: ANA Holdings announced that information regarding up to 37,800 passengers was leaked due to the breach at Amadeus. The company is monitoring for any fraudulent use of the data.

incidents.title: Korean Air data affected by global Amadeus reservation platform breach
incidents.summary: Korean Air confirmed that its data was affected by the unauthorized access to Amadeus reservation systems. Specific record counts were not immediately disclosed in initial reports.

incidents.title: Condor confirms data impacted by Amadeus cybersecurity incident
incidents.summary: German carrier Condor joined the list of airlines whose data was affected by the breach at Amadeus. The airline did not provide immediate details on the volume of records compromised.

incidents.title: Auto-Planning France software data leak after cyberattack on its sites
incidents.summary: Auto-Planning, a French software company, reported a data leak on November 2 after a cyberattack on its sites. The company is investigating the incident and implementing containment measures.

incidents.title: Brico Dépôt France retail DIY cyberattack 57,109 truck rental invoices leaked
incidents.summary: Brico Dépôt, a French DIY retail chain, reported a cyberattack on November 2 where 57,109 truck rental invoices were leaked. The hacker Venus1337 claimed responsibility, citing an IDOR vulnerability.

incidents.victim: Abgeordnete der Fraktion Die Linke im Deutschen Bundestag
incidents.title: Abgeordnete der Fraktion Die Linke im Deutschen Bundestag Germany government political email flooding attack
incidents.summary: Abgeordnete der Fraktion Die Linke im Deutschen Bundestag reported an email flooding attack on November 2 that overwhelmed inboxes. The incident is under investigation.

incidents.title: Northflank Warns of Security Breach Leading to API Key Abuse
incidents.summary: Cloud hosting platform Northflank warned customers to rotate all credentials after a security breach led to unauthorized use of AI API keys. The incident was detected by Wiz, and the company advised assuming environment variables were decrypted.

incidents.title: Abrigo Restores Sageworks App After Outage From Suspected Cyberattack
incidents.summary: Financial technology company Abrigo restored its Sageworks risk management application following an outage triggered by irregular activity. Borrower-facing capabilities remain disabled while the investigation into the cyberattack continues.

incidents.title: Poryadok Home Goods Chain Suffers Cyberattack Disrupting Operations
incidents.summary: Russian home goods chain Poryadok suffered a cyberattack that forced the suspension of online services and operations in some stores for five days. The company confirmed the attack but did not disclose how hackers breached its systems.

incidents.title: Qantas Probes Amadeus Cyber Incident Impacting Airline Bookings
incidents.summary: Qantas and other airlines are assessing impacts after a cyber attack on travel technology provider Amadeus disrupted reservation systems. Qantas stated its own systems remained secure while working with Amadeus to understand booking impacts.

incidents.title: Email-flooding attack overwhelms Die Linke lawmakers' inboxes
incidents.summary: An email-flooding attack overwhelmed the inboxes of the party's Bundestag lawmakers, while parliamentary email overall remained operational. The incident was reported on 2 November.

incidents.title: Cyprus bank hit by 200-hour DDoS attack lasting more than eight days
incidents.summary: A distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack on a bank in Cyprus lasted 200 hours in the third quarter of 2026, according to cybersecurity company Qrator Labs. The prolonged attack highlights risks for financial institutions in the region.

incidents.title: Deutscher Bundestag und Bundesregierung Germany government possible cyberattack targeting phones
incidents.summary: The Deutscher Bundestag und Bundesregierung reported a possible cyberattack on November 2 targeting lawmakers' and officials' phones. The compromise is not confirmed, and the incident is under investigation.

incidents.title: N0n claims ransomware attack on US dental insurance firm Company #117
incidents.summary: The ransomware group N0n publicly claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Company #117, a US-based entity involved in dental insurance. The threat actor hinted at pending exposure of sensitive data unless demands were met.

incidents.title: N0n claims ransomware attack on US biopharmaceutical Company #114
incidents.summary: The ransomware group N0n publicly claimed responsibility for a cyberattack against Company #114, a US-based biopharmaceutical company. The group threatened to release sensitive data unless a settlement was reached.

incidents.title: Settra claims ransomware attack on US engineering firm Mackin Engineering
incidents.summary: The ransomware group Settra declared a successful cyberattack against Mackin Engineering Company, a well-known US engineering firm. The group threatened to release sensitive financial data unless the company engages in negotiations.

incidents.title: Hackers Claim Takeover of Russian Statistics Agency Rosstat
incidents.summary: An alliance of Belarusian and pro-Ukrainian hackers claimed to have taken down Russia's federal statistics agency Rosstat and stolen sensitive government data. The claim remains unverified by official Russian sources.

incidents.title: N0n ransomware group claims attacks on five unnamed US companies
incidents.summary: The N0n ransomware group claimed responsibility for attacks on five unnamed US entities including retail, biopharma, gaming, identity resolution, and dental insurance firms. Data exposure was pending.

incidents.title: Distributed Denial of Secrets Leaks DHS Worker Data of 41,000 Individuals
incidents.summary: Data belonging to more than 41,000 Department of Homeland Security workers was leaked publicly by Distributed Denial of Secrets. The released records included operation names, surveillance programs, and employee contact details.

incidents.title: Asoview data breach exposes over 15 million customer records
incidents.summary: Travel booking platform Asoview confirmed a data breach affecting over 15.8 million records due to unauthorized access at its email provider Arara. Customer contact details were exposed in the incident.

incidents.title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa announces cyberattack enabling fraud
incidents.summary: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa announced it had been the target of a cyberattack that enabled fraudulent transactions. The group stated that clients' assets have not been affected and operations are gradually resuming.

incidents.title: Mercado Bitcoin Says Hacker Attack Contained With No Data Leakage
incidents.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Mercado Bitcoin suffered a hacker attack but stated in an official statement that the incident was contained. The brokerage confirmed that customers suffered no loss and no data was leaked.

incidents.title: Beget cloud infrastructure wiped in destructive cyberattack
incidents.summary: Attackers gained access to infrastructure-management systems and ran scripts designed to erase data, destroying data across the cloud provider's infrastructure and disrupting hundreds of websites. The attack occurred on 1 November and restoration was expected to take considerable time.

incidents.title: HelloDepann France home services data leak addresses and repair records of 4,651 clients
incidents.summary: HelloDepann, a French home services provider, reported a data leak on November 2 exposing addresses and repair records of 4,651 clients. The hacker Alduin claimed responsibility, citing an insecure API.

incidents.title: Cholet Agglomération telephone service disrupted by cyberattack
incidents.summary: A cyberattack disrupted municipal telephone services for the French city. The city notice updated on November 1, 2026, indicated that the telephone service was operational again.

incidents.victim: Secretaria de Estado de Saúde de Mato Grosso
incidents.title: Brazilian state health department IT systems shut down after second attack
incidents.summary: After a second attack this year, IT systems at the Secretaria de Estado de Saúde de Mato Grosso were shut down, restricting some hospital services. The department is investigating the cause.

incidents.title: Ukraine air raid alert app sent false alerts after being hacked
incidents.summary: The Air Alert app briefly displayed false alerts about radiation and chemical threats as well as street fighting. Other public warning channels remained available, and the Ukrainian Air Force confirmed the hack.

incidents.title: Rushcliffe Spencer Academy pupils' photographs and reports exposed in data breach
incidents.summary: Rushcliffe Spencer Academy apologized after a data breach exposed pupils' photographs, reports, and timetables. The school has secured its systems and notified parents.

incidents.title: St. Luke's Medical Center probes unauthorized access to eHealth Hub mobile app platform
incidents.summary: St. Luke's Medical Center reported unauthorized access to a third-party platform supporting its eHealth Hub mobile app, potentially affecting patient and employee data. The National Privacy Commission was notified.

incidents.title: ATB Ukraine grocery retailer confirms cyberattack and extortion demand
incidents.summary: ATB, a Ukrainian grocery retailer, confirmed a cyberattack after hackers posted an extortion demand threatening to leak data. The company is working to restore systems and assess damage.

incidents.title: Capcon gaming company confirms data breach affecting over 11.7 million users
incidents.summary: Capcom confirmed a data breach affecting more than 11.7 million Capcom ID users due to phishing. The company issued warnings and is assisting affected users with security measures.

incidents.title: Clifford Chance UK global legal services cybersecurity breach clients notified
incidents.summary: Clifford Chance, a global legal services firm, reported a cybersecurity breach in November 2026. Clients were notified, and the firm is investigating the incident.

incidents.title: Weverse Company South Korea entertainment fan platform data breach
incidents.summary: Weverse Company, a South Korean entertainment and fan platform, reported a data breach in November 2026. The company is investigating the incident and implementing containment measures.

incidents.title: Malaysia Airlines passenger data exposed via Amadeus travel-tech provider breach
incidents.summary: Malaysia Airlines stated that passenger data may have been exposed due to a breach at travel-tech provider Amadeus. The incident occurred approximately three years ago and is under investigation.

incidents.title: Attacker offers data from Groupe MPA sites claiming 1.7 million client records
incidents.summary: An actor listed data from eleven Groupe MPA websites for sale on a cybercrime forum, claiming to hold approximately 1.7 million client records. Groupe MPA, a French online seller of license plates and signage, has not publicly confirmed the breach.

incidents.title: BYOD gang claims 1.3 million student records in MSU ransomware attack
incidents.summary: The BYOD ransomware group listed Michigan State University on its leak site, claiming to hold personal data on 1.3 million current and former students. MSU stated it has not determined that any personal information was compromised.

incidents.title: Revolve Retailer Confirms Data Theft of Payment Card Information
incidents.summary: Online fashion retailer Revolve announced that cybercriminals gained access to its e-commerce platform and stole payment card numbers and expiration dates. The company notified regulators in Texas and Vermont about the incident.

incidents.title: Novabio reports cyberattacks exposing patient health data
incidents.summary: The medical biology laboratory confirmed a cybersecurity incident affecting its Quality system that may have exposed identity and health data of some patients. It also reported a second incident at its provider Maileva affecting patients of several Inovie laboratories.

incidents.title: DDoS attacks on Dutch government login service DigiD raise resilience concerns
incidents.summary: Repeated DDoS attacks on DigiD, the Netherlands' national login service, have exposed fragility in the government login backbone. The incidents have raised questions about resilience, maintenance, and future hosting arrangements.

incidents.title: Maplebear Inc. (CART) discloses a cybersecurity incident in an 8-K
incidents.summary: Maplebear Inc. filed a Form 8-K with the SEC on 2026-10-29 that discusses a cybersecurity incident. Read the filing for scope and impact.

incidents.title: Doordash, Inc. (DASH) discloses a cybersecurity incident in an 8-K
